Interface MessageBodyHandlerSelector

public interface MessageBodyHandlerSelector
A bean that chooses the MessageBodyReader or MessageBodyWriter of a lookup in the default MessageBodyHandlerRegistry, instead of the first applicable candidate.

The registry passes every bean candidate whose declared type and media types match the lookup, in its default order (candidates with a matching @Consumes / @Produces first), before asking isReadable / isWriteable. The registration gives access to the bean definition (type arguments, annotation metadata), so a selector can apply its own ranking. The returned handler is cached per type and media types like the default choice; a selector that needs to decide per value may return a handler that delegates.

Selectors are consulted in order; the first non-null result wins. When every selector returns null, the registry picks the first candidate that is readable / writeable for one of the media types.
